name: Szigliget (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Szigliget: a blue shield with a white castle, with a helm, a horse crest and blue and yellow mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Szigliget arms with helm, crest and mantling
